That was a scary business.|A pilot who participated in the battle|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref>}}
Years before the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], a '''rebellion''' occurred on the planet [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], fought between the rebel sect known as the [[Temple of the Beatific Razor]] and the reigning [[Caliph]]s. The conflict ended thanks to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] intervention by the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]].
